candidates.topic: Waning Gibbous Moon in Cancer — Emotional Reckoning
candidates.teaser: The Moon is in Cancer right now — and it's pulling something up from deep inside you that you've been trying to ignore.
candidates.video_title: Moon in Cancer Is Exposing What You've Been Hiding
candidates.video_description: The Waning Gibbous Moon in Cancer on November 26 activates deep emotional processing. Astrologers associate this placement with surfacing buried feelings around home, family, and security. Three planets are still retrograde, amplifying the introspective pull.
candidates.script: The Moon in Cancer right now isn't gentle — it's excavating. We're in a Waning Gibbous phase, which in astrology is called the release window, the period where what you've been holding finally surfaces whether you're ready or not. Cancer rules home, family, and emotional memory. With Saturn, Uranus, and Neptune all still retrograde, there's nowhere to hide from what needs to be felt. The question isn't what's coming — it's what have you been carrying?

candidates.topic: Saturn Retrograde in Aries conjunct Neptune — Final Stretch
candidates.teaser: Saturn and Neptune are still locked together in Aries — and what that rare collision is quietly dismantling in your life might surprise you.
candidates.video_title: Saturn & Neptune in Aries — What They're Dismantling Now
candidates.video_description: Saturn sits at 8° Aries retrograde, Neptune at 1° Aries retrograde on November 26, 2026. Astrologers interpret this pairing as a rare tension between reality and illusion, structure and dissolution. Both retrograde deepens the internal pressure.
candidates.script: Saturn is at 8° Aries retrograde. Neptune is at 1° Aries retrograde. Two planets rarely this close, both moving backward — and in astrology, that combination is considered one of the most disorienting transits a generation can experience. Saturn wants hard truth. Neptune dissolves it. When they collide in retrograde, astrologers say the structures you built on illusions quietly begin to crack. The real question is: which of your certainties are actually borrowed beliefs?

candidates.topic: Mars enters Virgo at 0° — The Precision Shift
candidates.teaser: Mars just moved into Virgo — and astrologers say this is one of the most underestimated sign shifts of the year.
candidates.video_title: Mars at 0° Virgo — The Energy Shift Nobody Talks About
candidates.video_description: Mars has just entered Virgo at 0.3°, a critical ingress point. In astrology, 0° of any sign is considered raw, unfiltered energy of that archetype. Mars in Virgo is associated with precise, methodical action — a sharp contrast to its recent Leo placement.
candidates.script: Mars just crossed into Virgo — sitting right at 0.3°, which in astrology is called a critical ingress, the rawest, most unfiltered expression of that sign's energy. After weeks of Mars amplified in Leo, the shift is sharp. Virgo Mars is associated with precision, strategy, and fixing what's broken — but astrologers warn it can also turn that drive inward as harsh self-criticism. The fire didn't go out. It just got a scalpel. Which part of your life needs that kind of attention?

candidates.topic: Venus at 25° Libra — The Final Degree Warning
candidates.teaser: Venus is about to leave its home sign — and the last degrees of any planet's journey are where things get urgent.
candidates.video_title: Venus at 25° Libra — What Late Degrees Actually Mean
candidates.video_description: Venus sits at 25.9° Libra on November 26, approaching the final stretch before sign change. In astrology, the late degrees of a sign — especially 28° and 29° — are called anaretic degrees, associated with urgency and unfinished business in that sign's themes.
candidates.script: Venus is at 25° Libra right now, and that matters more than most people realize. In astrology, as a planet approaches the final degrees of a sign, its themes intensify — relationships, fairness, beauty, the desire to be chosen. Libra is Venus's home, so this isn't just any exit. Astrologers often describe late-degree Venus in Libra as a last call for balance in partnerships before the energy shifts entirely. Something in your closest relationships is asking for resolution. Are you listening?

candidates.topic: The Astrological 8th House — What It Actually Rules
candidates.teaser: Most people think the 8th house is just about death — but astrologers say what it really rules is far more personal than that.
candidates.video_title: The 8th House — Astrology's Most Feared Placement Explained
candidates.video_description: The 8th house in astrology is widely misunderstood. Beyond its association with death and transformation, it rules shared resources, intimacy, psychological depth, inheritance, and other people's money. Scorpio and Pluto are its traditional rulers.
candidates.script: The 8th house isn't the death house — that's the story people tell to avoid what it actually means. In astrology, the 8th rules what you share with another person at the deepest level: money, power, secrets, intimacy, transformation. It's the house of what you cannot control and cannot avoid. Ruled by Scorpio and Pluto, it governs the parts of life that change you permanently. Whatever sits in your 8th house isn't a warning — it's a map to your most significant transformation. What's yours?
